name: Banti Singh
summary: I build scalable, production-grade web applications end-to-end — from pixel-perfect UIs to high-performance backend APIs. {years}+ years turning complex requirements into clean, maintainable code.
pdfSummary: Full Stack Web Developer with 3+ years of experience architecting and building scalable web and mobile applications. Proven expertise in Angular, React, Next.js, .NET Core, Node.js, and Flutter. Experienced in designing enterprise EHS platforms, double-entry financial ledger systems, and high-throughput RESTful APIs.

lesson.text: Built a dynamic Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system end-to-end — granular per-action permissions (view/create/edit/delete), role-driven admin sidebar, permission hooks, and Redis-backed caching with cache invalidation.

Led the wallet decoupling effort, adding OwnerType/OwnerId to the wallet model so both end-users and merchants share one wallet abstraction, with null-safe ledger owner resolution and auto wallet creation for marketplace merchants.

Implemented QR-verified account statements: server-side bank-format PDF generation (QuestPDF), a backend data API consumed by the Flutter app, a public verification portal, and embedded logo + QR watermarking.
Delivered profession-based wallet limits with a maker-checker dual-approval workflow, plus configurable balance-limit banners driven by AppConfig across web and mobile.
Hardened financial safety across the platform — remediated 59+ audit findings covering null-reference crashes, silent SQL failures, duplicate prevention, and refund/credit rollback guarantees.
Developed an Influencer Referral Program across the stack — data models, services, webhook + conversion attribution hooks (Adjust device ID), and admin portal management pages.
Built the Close Monitoring compliance feature — transaction tagging by monitoring period, compliance indicators/filters, and dedicated admin UI (per BRD requirements).
Unified the merchant admin portal into a single create wizard with shared components and multi-merchant portal-user linking, replacing fragmented per-type screens.
Added TOTP multi-factor authentication (backend + admin UI), Google login, and KYC document type-mismatch detection during verification.

Created a database migration framework (WalletMigrationRunner) that auto-runs SQL migrations on startup and a SchemaSync service that auto-detects indexes, foreign keys, and defaults from the EF Core DbContext.
Worked across the full stack: ASP.NET Core (.NET) APIs, Next.js/React admin dashboard, and the Flutter mobile app — including real-time order notifications, card PIN lockout, and cart/order fixes.

Developed and maintained multiple EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) web applications for enterprise clients including Pidilite, Coca-Cola, HACCPBL, and Galaxy, delivering end-to-end features across frontend, backend, and deployment on IIS servers.
Built configurable dashboards and reporting systems with drag-and-drop layouts, custom charts, and shared dashboards used across cross-functional teams.
Implemented authentication and security integrations including SSO and OAuth, ensuring secure enterprise-level access, and integrated third-party APIs for automated data synchronization workflows.
Collaborated closely with QA, product teams, and enterprise clients to resolve production issues, iterate on features, and deliver production-ready releases on schedule.
Independently developed modules such as Visitor Management Systems and operational workflow tools from scratch.
Designed and developed a Work Permit Management module from scratch, including permit lifecycle workflows, approval systems, role-based access, and real-time status tracking.
Coordinated with multiple teams and vendors for requirement gathering, integration planning, and smooth delivery execution.
Led pilot phases with clients, gathered feedback, iterated features, and successfully delivered production-ready releases.

bullets.text: Developed a self-service reporting and dashboard platform enabling users to create custom reports and charts with drag-and-drop dashboard configuration, real-time filtering, grouping, multi-level drill-down, and export (PDF, Excel, CSV).
Designed reusable chart and report components with configurable metadata, reducing developer dependency and enabling faster feature delivery.
Optimized SQL queries and backend API responses to support concurrent users with consistent sub-second performance.
Export support for PDF, Excel, and CSV formats with asynchronous job queues.

Designed and developed a custom project and task management system for an architecture company to manage ongoing projects efficiently with task tracking, status updates, deadlines, and team assignments.
Built modules for site visit scheduling and documentation, improving coordination between office and on-site teams.
Developed MOM (Minutes of Meeting) management to record discussions, action items, and follow-ups for each project.
Created role-based access and dashboards to provide clear visibility of project progress and responsibilities.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
